data.narrative:
Gecko Robotics is a Series D robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $125M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables in robotics and manufacturing, supplemented by a broader universe of eight private firms and one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using total capital raised as a proxy baseline, applies a typical Series D-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.5x to the $125M raised, implying a valuation of $188M. Peer-median analysis examines five robotics comparables spanning Series C through Series E: Divergent ($2.3B, Series E), Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Hadrian ($1.6B, Series C), Agile Robots ($1.0B, Series C), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B, Series C). The median valuation across this cohort is $1.6B, with a range from $1.0B to $2.3B.

Triangulating these two methods yields a valuation range of $159M (low) to $1.8B (high), with a median of $894M. The wide dispersion reflects tension between stage-progression mechanics and peer comparables. Key uncertainties include (1) whether Gecko's unit economics and revenue trajectory align with the higher-end comparable set, particularly Exotec at $2.0B Series D valuation, and (2) the appropriateness of applying Series C valuations given Gecko's later stage. Resolution requires revenue, growth rate, and margin data relative to peers.
